content.title: Sept. consumer sentiment falls, Moderna & COVID report, Gemini IPO

Yahoo Finance's John Hyland tracks Friday's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute.

Moderna (MRNA) stock is sinking on a Washington Post report that Trump administration health officials will link a number of deaths to COVID-19 vaccine shots.

Gemini shares will reportedly open at $32, according to Bloomberg.

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.

content.title: Review & Preview: Waiting for the Rate Cut
content.summary: The Friday divergence sets up a big week for investors with the Federal Reserve set to meet Tuesday and Wednesday, before announcing its closely watched interest-rate decision Wednesday afternoon.  The tech-heavy Nasdaq stood out today thanks in part to a big gain from Tesla.  “The move comes after Tesla stock added 6% on Thursday, helped in part by in-line inflation data that solidified investors’ belief that rate cuts are coming,” Al wrote today.

content.title: Drugmakers Fall on Report US to Claim Covid Shot Killed Kids
content.summary: The Washington Post reported Friday that a group of health officials appear to have used the Vaccine Adverse Event Reporting System, or VAERS, to tie the deaths of 25 children to Covid vaccines.  A high-profile advisory committee that Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. revamped to include vaccine critics is scheduled to discuss the shots from companies including Pfizer Inc., Moderna Inc. and BioNTech SE at its meeting next week.  The Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices is also scheduled to vote on recommendations for vaccines for measles, hepatitis B and Covid, according to a draft agenda posted Friday evening.

content.title: Vaccine Stocks Fall Following Report of Plans to Link Covid Shot With Child Deaths
content.summary: Shares of vaccine companies fell after a report that federal officials plan to link Covid-19 vaccines with child deaths.  Pfizer shares declined 4%, Novavax shares fell 3.6%, Moderna shares were down 7.4% and BioNTech shares closed 7.3% lower.  The Washington Post reported Friday that federal health officials plan to link the vaccines to the deaths of 25 children during a presentation next week to advisers to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

content.title: Why Moderna (MRNA) Shares Are Trading Lower Today
content.summary: Shares of biotechnology company Moderna (NASDAQ:MRNA) fell 7.8% in the afternoon session after reports revealed Trump administration health officials plan to link COVID-19 vaccines to the deaths of around two dozen children.

content.title: Why Pfizer (PFE) Shares Are Sliding Today
content.summary: Shares of global pharmaceutical company Pfizer (NYSE:PFE) fell 3.5% in the afternoon session after reports revealed federal health officials are planning to link COVID-19 vaccines to the deaths of children.
